checkpoint.scope: On-disk settings only; game memory/closed-client state not asserted. No settings writes, profiling changes, or game input.

behavior: Manager slider1.00 now means70percent native scale, preserving stored slider values and existing X/Y/collapse behavior. Hidden native selection/ready-check overlays inherit hidden ancestor alpha as well as retaining direct alpha suppression. Late native setup/selection updates are securely post-hooked; anonymous pooled children recognized by native parent identity. Display-only suppression handles late combat highlights; geometry remains deferred.

sourceEvidence.verification: Fresh five-branch commit resolutions and pinned SimpleRegionAPI fetches: SetAlpha and SetIgnoreParentAlpha are unprotected; ignore argument is publicfalse. Pinned native CUF XML marks selection and ready-check layers ignoreParentAlpha; actual native selection/manager/ready handlers replayed in tests.

restoration: Weak snapshots of original parent-alpha flags and readable alpha values restored on disable; newer external changes retained. Opaque alpha is never compared or guessed. Native frame events/scripts/parent/visibility and raid profiles remain Blizzard-owned. No native aura descendant queries.
